instruction: Please help change GIMP's icon theme from 'Color' to 'Legacy'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP's icon theme setting from the default 'Color' to 'Legacy' via Edit > Preferences > Interface > Icon Theme. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for (icon-theme "Legacy") using the existing check_config_status metric. This is similar in difficulty to the original theme change task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: changing GIMP's icon theme to 'Legacy'
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to flush settings to disk before verification
Getter successfully reads the gimprc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric function check_config_status correctly parses LISP-like config format (icon-theme "Legacy") and matches against expected rule
Expected value format is correct: {"key": "icon-theme", "value": "\"Legacy\""} matches the actual gimprc format with escaped quotes
Data flow is correct: postconfig -> getter extracts config file -> metric checks key-value -> returns 1.0 if match
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement in the instruction
Runtime feasibility confirmed: all components will work correctly at execution time
